content.introduction: TechCrunch is a news platform that provides reporting on the business of technology, startups, venture capital funding, and Silicon Valley. It was founded in June 2005 by Michael Arrington and Keith Teare and was acquired by AOL in 2010 for approximately $25 million. The site was owned by Verizon Media from 2015 through 2021. TechCrunch hosts an annual tech conference, TechCrunch Disrupt, and previously sponsored the Crunchies award ceremony from 2007 to 2017. The sources do not provide a definitive answer regarding the current ownership or specific events beyond TechCrunch's general operations and history.
body:
TechCrunch is an American global online newspaper focusing on topics regarding high-tech and startup companies. It was founded in June 2005 by Archimedes Ventures, led by partners Michael Arrington and Keith Teare. In 2010, AOL acquired the company for approximately $25 million. Following the 2015 acquisition of AOL and Yahoo! by Verizon, the site was owned by Verizon Media from 2015 through 2021. [...] [edit]

Starting in New York City in 2010, TechCrunch hosts an annual tech conference, TechCrunch Disrupt, in several cities in the United States and Europe. The event brings entrepreneurs, investors and tech enthusiasts together to watch startups pitch their ideas to a panel of judges, participate in networking events, listen to keynote speeches and panel discussions.

### Startup Battlefield

[edit] [...] [edit]

From 2007 to 2017, TechCrunch sponsored the annual Crunchies award ceremony to award startups, internet, and technology innovations. At the first award ceremony in 2007, Facebook won the award for best startup. TechCrunch announced in 2017 that it would end the Crunchies.
